## The audience decision

New students saw a long program before they knew where to start. The first campaign question was which activity could give them a useful and realistic first visit.

## My contribution

I wrote the audience brief, proposed the sequence of messages, and reviewed the captions with the design lead. The team managed publication and event operations.

## What went live

The poster offered three starting activities and shared the same language as the registration page. Each follow-up addressed one practical question about attendance.
